name: gutenslider
description: Slider block for the block editor: images, videos and any blocks on top.
author: Niklas Jurij Plessing <niklas@eedee.net> (https://eedee.net)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build && npm run env:start && npm run seed
scripts.i18n: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/gutenslider wp i18n make-pot . languages/gutenslider.pot --slug=gutenslider --domain=gutenslider '--exclude=node_modules,vendor,tests,artifacts,bin,src,dist,.archive,.claude,.git,languages,*.zip' && wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/gutenslider wp i18n update-po languages/gutenslider.pot && wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/gutenslider wp i18n make-mo languages && wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/gutenslider wp i18n make-json languages --no-purge && wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/gutenslider wp i18n make-php languages
